data: Geofabrik OpenStreetMap extracts 2026-11 (ODbL). Local verification asset, not shipped.
notes: Measured = Valhalla /route static free-flow time: no traffic, no elevation data, default speeds. Real door-to-door times are usually longer.
ratio = Sidequest estimate / measured minutes. Below 1 = estimator too fast.
Geometry classes are proxies from road/straight detour, speed, ferry flag and region terrain; no elevation used.
estimateLegMinutes includes overhead (8 min drive, 2 walk) and rounds to 5 minutes; measured figures have neither.
Pairs with a route endpoint snapped over 3 km from the point are excluded and listed in failures.

Summary tables and worst lists use the clean subset only (recorded scan pairs and settlement-to-settlement atlas pairs, snap <= 1 km, road >= 0.9 x straight line); parks and ranges are centroids and their snap is arbitrary. records holds everything, with cleanness computable from settlements, source, snapKm.
